key.description:
Only the device open/close actions a client reports; server-generated
keys are written by their own flows, not forgeable through this endpoint.

reason.description: Required when `key` is `entry_point.open_failure` or `entry_point.close_failure`, optional otherwise. On a failure, short text saying what went wrong. On an unconfirmed key, the cause token for that outcome; see [Reporting a tap](/guides/white-label/quickstart#reporting-a-tap).

error_code.description: Why the tap failed, as one of the server's snake_case error codes (see [Reporting a tap](/guides/white-label/quickstart#reporting-a-tap)). Any other value is accepted but stored as null.

first_error_code.description: The error code of the first failed attempt, when the tap took more than one. Same values as `error_code`.

scanned_lock_serial.description: The lock the phone actually reached: `"0x"` followed by the lock SDK's `session.lockId`.

field_lost_after_start.description: `true` when the lock started the action and the phone moved away before it finished (the lock SDK's `fieldLostAfterStart` outcome). Send it with the successful key.

package.description: Optional: the name of the library that ran the tap, for diagnostics.

package_version.description: Optional: the version of that library.
